You can use the sorted() function or the .sort() method. sorted() returns a new list while .sort() modifies in place.

Neural networks are computational models inspired by the human brain, consisting of layers of interconnected nodes.

Java's garbage collector automatically manages memory by identifying and disposing of objects no longer referenced by the program.
